#Load packages
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
list.of.packages = c("base","spearmanCI","tidyr", "readr","dplyr", "ggplot2","psych" , "ggpubr","stats","rstatix", "pwr","Hmisc","ggfortify","apaTables","kableExtra", "Routliers","viridis","stringr","data.table","interactions","effectsize","flextable","officer","tidyverse","car","patchwork","ggsignif")


new.packages <- list.of.packages[!(list.of.packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
if(length(new.packages) > 0) {install.packages(new.packages)}
lapply(list.of.packages, require, character.only=T)
```


#pooled data CEs

##load data
```{r}
full.sdt=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/full_SDT_outlierremoved.csv"))[,-1]
full.sdt <- full.sdt %>%
  dplyr::select("Participant","dprime","c","condition")
names(full.sdt)[1]="subjectID"

full.cea=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/full_CEA_outlierremoved.csv"))[,-1]

full.acc=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/full_acc_outremoved.csv"))[,-1]
names(full.acc)[1]="subjectID"
cond=full.cea %>% dplyr::select(subjectID,condition)
full.acc=left_join(full.acc,cond)

full.optdev=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/full_optdev_outremoved.csv"))[,-1]

all.mlu=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/mlu_outremoved.csv"))[,-1]
all.steu=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/steu_outremoved.csv"))[,-1]
all.steu=all.steu %>% dplyr::select(subjectID,condition,STEU_score,STEU_sub_score,STEU_untrained)
all.emo.verb=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/emo_verb_outremoved.csv"))[,-1]



```

```{r}
all=full_join(full.cea,full.acc,by=c("subjectID","condition"))
all=full_join(all,full.sdt,by=c("subjectID","condition"))
all=full_join(all,full.optdev,by=c("subjectID","condition"))
all=full_join(all,all.steu,by=c("subjectID","condition"))
all=full_join(all,all.emo.verb,by=c("subjectID","condition"))
all=full_join(all,all.mlu,by=c("subjectID","condition"))

```

##Whether STEU-emoseg link vary across conditions?
###CEA
```{r,echo=FALSE}
model=lm(CEA_ave~STEU_score*condition,data=all) #
summary(model)
```


```{r}
sim_slopes(
  model,
  STEU_score,
  condition,
  modx.values = NULL,
  centered = "all",
  cond.int = TRUE,
  confint=TRUE
)
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
model=lm(CEA_ave~STEU_sub_score*condition,data=all) 
summary(model)
```
